summary.text: Nicholas DiLorenzo is the Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives in the Orange-2 District in the November 3, 2026 general election. He works in social services and is a former member of the United States National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Nicholas DiLorenzo served in the United States National Guard from 2008 to 2014 and earned an associate degree from Burlington College.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes working in social services; he advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, DiLorenzo said he has been involved in community service and leadership through Scouts, Bradford athletics, community clean-up initiatives and Civil Air Patrol.

He listed his campaign messages as an affordable Vermont with reduced government spending and lower taxes, safe communities with strong law enforcement and judicial accountability, and education that he said should focus on life fundamentals while spending is held to account.
He also said he is passionate about public safety and emergency services and about expanding access to mental health and substance abuse treatment.
